title: Conversion requirement with no rate source anywhere in the repo
brief: Finance filed: 'Receipts must show the total converted into the customer's currency. The system stores amounts as USD cents.' The repo below has render_total, which currently renders the raw USD amount next to the caller's currency code - no conversion is applied. Nothing in the repo supplies a conversion rate: there is no FX table, no rate file, no per-customer currency record, and no rate passed by the caller. Different rate choices produce different receipt text. If you can implement the conversion unambiguously using only what the repo provides, respond VERDICT: REPAIR. If a concrete decision is missing, respond VERDICT: ESCALATE with MISSING naming the exact decision needed and WHY it changes observable behavior.

"""Receipt total rendering for the order service."""


def render_total(amount_usd_cents, currency_code):
    """Renders a receipt total converted from stored USD cents into the
    customer's display currency.

    FIXME(finance): conversion not implemented - see brief.
    """
    return "%s %.2f" % (currency_code, amount_usd_cents / 100.0)  # no conversion applied
